barc-gold-nanoparticle-photothermal-2026.identity: Intravenous gold nanoparticles and one to three near infrared heating sessions for superficial gross tumors.
barc-gold-nanoparticle-photothermal-2026.recruitment_sites: Direct BARC roster active; Edmonds, WA is the sole named site.
barc-gold-nanoparticle-photothermal-2026.eligibility: Dogs: MCT >2 cm, STS <2 cm, oral melanoma 2–3 cm, cutaneous/foot melanoma <2 cm; cats: oral SCC without bone invasion or selected cutaneous MCT, sarcoma and carcinoma.
barc-gold-nanoparticle-photothermal-2026.funding: Current cost/coverage unspecified; historical funding terms do not transfer.
barc-gold-nanoparticle-photothermal-2026.deadline: No dated enrollment or study completion cutoff in exact section.

barc-scc-intratumoral-carboplatin-2026.identity: Long-acting low-dose intratumoral carboplatin; common protocol ID with LSU not established.
barc-scc-intratumoral-carboplatin-2026.recruitment_sites: Exact section Active Enrollment and Currently Ongoing at BARC Edmonds.
barc-scc-intratumoral-carboplatin-2026.eligibility: Canine confirmed superficial SCC with ≥1cm measurable lesion, no metastasis, no prior chemo, RT or immunotherapy, adequate organs and counts.
barc-scc-intratumoral-carboplatin-2026.funding: Study treatment and study-associated procedures funded; no general unrelated-care promise.

cornell-oscc-trametinib.identity: Once-daily oral trametinib, with days 14/42/70/108/126 follow-up and final CT/biopsies.
cornell-oscc-trametinib.recruitment_sites: Current Cornell list plus independently explicit Active Trial at COOL; Ithaca CUHA only.
cornell-oscc-trametinib.eligibility: Dog with oral SCC; hospital exact criteria says diagnosed; lab can prescreen strong suspicion. Keep diagnosed required for enrollment, unknown requires screening.
cornell-oscc-trametinib.funding: Drug and study visits/procedures covered, additional $1,000 credit for standard-care oral SCC expenses conditional on completing study.
cornell-oscc-trametinib.contacts: Santiago Peralta; CUHA dentistry or oncology/clinical trials 607-253-3060, vet-research@cornell.edu.
cornell-oscc-trametinib.deadline: 126 days is individual follow-up, not recruitment deadline; no published end.

cornell-smart-start-bcell-lymphoma.identity: Profile-guided pretreatment: four tablets over 14 days or five daily injections, followed by standard CHOP; no placebo.
cornell-smart-start-bcell-lymphoma.recruitment_sites: Listed by current CUHA clinical program and exact Ithaca trial invitation.
cornell-smart-start-bcell-lymphoma.eligibility: Diagnosed canine B-cell lymphoma, no previous treatment except prednisolone, willing to use CHOP.
cornell-smart-start-bcell-lymphoma.funding: Study tests/procedures no extra cost, standard care charged with 10% discount at applicable visits and $1,000 toward chemotherapy.
cornell-smart-start-bcell-lymphoma.deadline: 14 days is pretreatment window; no recruitment or study end date published.

jp-gifu-feline-oscc-radiotherapy-lavurch.identity: Radiotherapy with Lavurchin/SQAP for five days, rechecks at 1, 3 and 6 months.
jp-gifu-feline-oscc-radiotherapy-lavurch.recruitment_sites: Official Gifu current Web roster and Work individual page explicitly invite affected cats, Gifu Animal Medical Center only.
jp-gifu-feline-oscc-radiotherapy-lavurch.eligibility: Feline oral SCC with planned radiotherapy; staging/prior-treatment or other clinical criteria not separately published.
jp-gifu-feline-oscc-radiotherapy-lavurch.funding: Lavurchin free; regular treatment costs including RT apply.
jp-gifu-feline-oscc-radiotherapy-lavurch.deadline: 2025-08-18 is publication date, not end; no cutoff in protocol or current roster.
